## Meals
- Meal plan print redesigned as an adaptive A4 fridge sheet: large readable type that expands on light weeks and compacts on busy weeks
- Always one A4 portrait page without shrinking the whole layout with CSS scale
- Compact guest counts on print; day headings like MONDAY 5 OCT

## Fixes
- Meal plan print no longer leaves a blank half-page or unreadable tiny text
